Packed ELF64 header, segment, section, symbol, relocation, and dynamic entry structs.

# Purpose
Defines packed C data structures for ELF64 file parsing and inspection. The file includes type definitions for the ELF64 file header, program header, section header, symbol table entry, relocation records, and dynamic section entry, all using fixed-size integer types from `fd_elf.h`. Each structure matches the ELF64 binary layout so code can read or write ELF data without padding changes from the compiler. The header guard prevents multiple inclusion of the file.
